font.reason: Variable family with a real 800 weight; geometric, confident headline voice matching the Helvetica 800 original. Its heavy joins keep the outlined (stroke-only) stage readable; Vazirmatn was tried and looked thinner/fussier when stroked; Lalezar/Baloo/Reem tried and rejected for seam noise or style.

comps.translatedSummary: سه واژهٔ مزیت «سریع‌تر / بهتر / قوی‌تر» با هندسهٔ اختصاصی هر واژه: دایرهٔ خط‌چین چرخان، سه دایرهٔ تو در تو که ترسیم می‌شوند، و برق فلزی که آخر سفید می‌شود.

rtlDecisions.why: Three comparatives with identical grammar, as the source prompt requires: سریع‌تر / بهتر / قوی‌تر (ZWNJ kept). Size 56 -> fs(56); lineHeight FA_LH; letterSpacing 0; no uppercase.

rtlDecisions.what: Outline->fill clip-path wipe of the first two words
rtlDecisions.why: Reveal follows reading direction: now starts at the right edge (inset(-20% 0 -20% X%)), same window/easing.
Sweep travels right->left (background-position 0%->100%) and the gradient band is mirrored 100deg->260deg so its slant keeps the same relation to travel; sheen->white timing unchanged.

rtlDecisions.what: Dashed circle spin (-90 + t*30 deg) and scale 0.4->1
rtlDecisions.why: Clockwise spinner rotation is physical, not reading direction; circle is symmetric.

Original rotate(-90) on the circle element also rotates cx, so the chain renders vertically (first=bottom, last=top, cropped by the frame). Up/down is physical; reproduced exactly as the original renders. Trim starts at top, clockwise, phase stagger 0.06 unchanged.
Gravity/up-down motion, random symmetric x distribution; seeds untouched.

rtlDecisions.what: Centered word block, scale-out 0.86, colours, glow
rtlDecisions.why: Symmetric centred composition; no balance problem after mirroring.

Stroked Persian text with transparent fill shows internal overlap seams at every letter join in all tested fonts. Now stroke 2px + paint-order stroke fill + opaque #07080c fill: only the outer ~1px outline remains (same visible thickness as the original 1px centred stroke). Trade-off: dust/circle lines no longer show through the glyph interior of the outline layer.
Sets direction:rtl, loads Estedad (delayRender) inside the 480x270 DesignStage so no fallback font is ever rendered.

rasterTextHandling: No raster assets; everything is DOM/SVG. Nothing to blur or mirror.
concerns: Persian words are shorter (Better) than the Latin originals, so the word sits visually smaller against the circles; sizes kept at fs(56) to preserve the design coordinates.
The original vertical stacking of the Better circles (rotate(-90) bug) is reproduced deliberately for fidelity.
lessons: Stroked (outline) Persian text shows overlap seams at every letter join with a transparent fill, in every font tried (Vazirmatn, Estedad, Lalezar, Baloo, Reem): use -webkit-text-stroke 2x width with paint-order:stroke fill and an opaque background-coloured fill to cover inner stroke halves/seams.

Check the original render before mirroring geometry: an SVG transform like rotate(-90) on an element with cx offset moves the element, so a designed horizontal chain may render vertical; mirror what is actually rendered, not what the code intends.
